cues: At a city docking station, commuters tap their passes before pedaling away for the final mile.
On a car-free riverside trail, families picnic beside the path as travelers pass through the park.
The newly protected lane separates morning commuters from traffic using concrete barriers and vivid green paint.
At an open-streets festival, families explore downtown roads closed to cars, stopping at food stalls and music stages.
On a forest trail, loose gravel and steep descents make steady balance more important than speed.
At a countryside lodge, guests gather early, fasten helmets, and set out along mapped rural roads.
